title: TSFM Meets LLM: Context as Covariates
abstract: arXiv:2611.05515v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Textual information is ubiquitous in real-world time series datasets, appearing as news, reports, and annotations that hold key predictive signals not deducible from numerical history alone. Large Language Models (LLMs) interpret text but lack numerical precision, while Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) are quantitatively accurate but cannot reason about the effects of text. Moreover, the lack of large-scale paired multimodal datasets limits progress in bridging this gap. In this work, we address this challenge by providing a scalable approach for generating realistic multimodal datasets by annotating real-world time series with LLMs. Building on this, we propose Context as Covariates (CoCo), a forecasting framework in which an LLM distills its textual reasoning into numerically grounded forecast and confidence covariates that guide a TSFM backbone, thereby exploiting the strengths of both LLMs and TSFMs. We align the two models in

translated_title: TSFM 遇见 LLM：作为协变量的上下文
translated_abstract: 文本信息在现实世界的时间序列数据集中无处不在，以新闻、报告和注释等形式出现，其中蕴含着仅凭数值历史无法推断出的关键预测信号。大语言模型（LLM）能够解读文本但缺乏数值精度，而时间序列基础模型（TSFM）在数值上精确却无法对文本的影响进行推理。此外，大规模成对多模态数据集的缺失也限制了弥合这一差距的研究进展。在本工作中，我们通过提供一种可扩展的方法来应对这一挑战，即利用 LLM 对真实世界的时间序列进行标注，从而生成逼真的多模态数据集。在此基础上，我们提出了“上下文作为协变量”预测框架 CoCo，其中 LLM 将其文本推理提炼为基于数值的预测协变量和置信度协变量，用以引导 TSFM 骨干模型，从而充分发挥 LLM 与 TSFM 各自的优势。我们将两种模型在……
tldr: 该论文提出 CoCo 预测框架，让 LLM 将文本推理转化为数值化的预测与置信度协变量来引导 TSFM 骨干模型，融合两者优势进行时间序列预测，并提供利用 LLM 标注真实时间序列以生成多模态数据集的可扩展方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CoCo, a forecasting framework in which an LLM distills textual reasoning into numerically grounded forecast and confidence covariates that guide a TSFM backbone, combining the strengths of both models, along with a scalable approach for generating realistic multimodal datasets by annotating real-world time series with LLMs.
